status: DRAFT, batch 2 of CODEC-V2-PLAN: authored against the deixis-codec-v2 CANDIDATE CONTRACT. Not frozen; a contract change before the freeze invalidates these octets, which are then re-derived, not patched.
source: CODEC.md v2 as merged on main at b42d777 (malformed_slot_codec_id; F1-F3; F4 and first-use precision)
method: Every byte string is hand-assembled from CODEC.md v2 §§3, 5, 6, 13, field by field as each note spells out, and never emitted by an implementation. min_profile is derived from fault_locus by tools/derive-vector-profiles.py's table, never typed. Chunk digests are SHA-256 computed with a tool over each chunk's published bytes: recompute, do not trust.
holding: Every decoding case states `holding`: the base slot-codec ids the decoder holds for that case (§2.1's modifier, stated with the ids it ranges over as §16 requires). option-of over a held id is held (§13). The harness decoder holds 00 01 and the fixture setoid's id unless a case says otherwise.
classes: class is §9's: invalid, unsupported, incomplete (need_more_input), or store for the store / traversal layer, which is never a decoder verdict. streaming_code, where present, is the verdict with the stream still open.
linked: A linked case names its root by address and gives the store as [digest, chunk-name] pairs. The store is untrusted: a digest need not be the SHA-256 of the chunk it names, which is how hash_mismatch is expressed. Chunks are named in this file's `chunks` or in codec-v2-linked.json. Every store case carries exactly one defect, because traversal order across a closure is unpinned.
streaming: A stream case refers to the flat case whose artifact it cuts (`ref`). `bytes` is what is fed, `cuts` the interior offsets at which it is split into pieces, `end` whether end of input is declared after the last piece. A complete root with the stream still open is need_more_input until end of input is declared (§14: F4).
envelope: Envelope cases carry their verdict under `expect`, not `code`: limit_exceeded is in no §2.1 row, by design, so the profile gate must not read it. `budget` maps §12 tokens to decimal strings; a dimension not named is at its §12 floor.

cases.name: v2-invalid/v1-artifact-is-unknown-magic
cases.note: A genuine deixis-codec-v1 artifact, the v1 corpus's flat/leaf-empty-payload, octet for octet. Its first four octets are 64 78 66 31 ("dxf1"), so a v2 decoder reads four octets that are not "dxf2". Old bytes stay historical (ADR 0011 §5): a v2 core that also accepts dxf1 fails here.

cases.name: v2-invalid/short-magic-is-eof

pins: Fewer than four is `unexpected_eof`
